entities.name: House Khone
entities.description: One of the five powerful houses in Arathoxia, ruled by a Black Knight; also known as House Jet.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: City with five powerful houses, ruined by Ravidel's invasion.

entities.name: Lord of House Khone
entities.description: Black Knight who ruled the house; survived the fortress's destruction.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Came into possession of the black Mox.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Stole the black Mox, used it to activate the Mox Beacon, and invaded Arathoxia.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Device activated using the black Mox.

entities.name: Planar Barge
entities.description: Vessel whose blast destroyed the Black Fortress.

entities.name: Black Fortress
entities.description: Fortress of House Khone in Arathoxia, destroyed in the invasion.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Home to which the Lord relocated.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Man whom the Lord refused to aid.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War that followed the ruin of Arathoxia.

events.summary: The Black Fortress was destroyed in Ravidel's invasion of Arathoxia, obliterated by a blast from the Planar Barge.
events.quote: The Black Fortress in Arathoxia was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of the city, obliterated by a blast from the Planar Barge.

events.summary: The Lord of the house survived, having left his fortress before its destruction.
events.quote: The Lord of the house survived, however, having left his fortress before its destruction.

events.summary: The Lord relocated to Golthonor and refused to aid Jared Carthalion out of fear of Ravidel's revenge.
events.quote: where he later refused to aid Jared Carthalion out of fear of Ravidel's revenge.
